dashboard_policy: Dashboards are not exposed or used and are not a release acceptance surface. Shared code remains in scope; dashboard failure matters only if it interferes with Agent, gateway, API or WebUI.

release_note_implications: Remote gateway refresh-token concurrency and event-loop fixes are relevant to gateway-backed WebUI operation.
SessionDB handle sharing/read-only attachment changes are relevant to long-lived gateway and WebUI processes.
No release note requires a destructive data migration for this fleet preparation.
Streaming, reconnect, run-journal and SessionDB fixes are relevant to the two WebUIs.
No stable release newer than v0.52.113 was published; exp-v0.52.* tags are not selected as stable releases.

isolated_execution.required_intervention: External authorization authority must issue the exact-command, short-lived, root-owned, read-only, single-use receipt and expose the external atomic consume socket, or run the same bounded test through an independently authorized host lane. Moss must not self-issue or bypass it.
isolated_execution.guard_runtime_inconsistency: The guard requires skill self-recreating-runtime-rollouts, but that skill is neither registered nor present in the visible skill roots. This does not waive the receipt requirement.
